title: Canonical restriction section transport is natural in coefficients
statement: For a commutative ring A, an open V of Spec A and a sheaf module M, construct the additive isomorphism from M(V) to global sections of the restriction of M to V by the open-image equality, restrictAppIso, and the inverse of overFunctorEquiv. For every coefficient morphism g:M→N and section s of M on V, transporting g(s) equals applying the restricted g to the transported s.

source.place: Tag 08C1, equation (20.40.0.1), compatibility of the section augmentation with the alternating total; Tag 01FM, increasing-tuple convention. The coordinate verification is written by X2.

proof.text: Transport the open equality using coefficient presheaf naturality. Apply naturality of the inverse of overFunctorEquiv, evaluated at the top open. Composing these two equations proves the claimed equality.
